title: Long-running JEV research synthesis classifier
author: Pukujan
body_excerpt:
## Goal

Deliver a model-agnostic, mostly deterministic research-synthesis workflow for correlated transcripts and papers. Preserve source lineage, citations, epistemic status, and separate valid time from transaction time. Human-readable papers are assembled from verified structured evidence.

## Non-negotiable rules
